title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: Interactive Spanish dental ERP prototype for fictional Clínica Dental Andina, one sourced shell and in-memory reset. S1-S40: complete reference/resource/patient/medicine CRUD with typed columns and protected links; editable patient identity document separate from immutable internal ID; descriptive free Lab/Imagen studies; no Triage. Structured human-selected diagnoses/Rx, clinical notes/recommendations/manual instructions, explicit textual save/complete, detached drafts and immutable closed snapshots. Only explicitly selected Aranceles services charge; integer-cent cash/non-payable QR settlement/receipts and outgoing Pagos ledger remain. Paid orders omit QR/payment controls and filler. Role-specific Navigation/menu/Resumen permissions are stable-ID based and intersect personal visibility; profile switching is demo-only. Login now has ONE genuine full-width visible Entrar a la demo text button, no inert duplicate caption: actual mouse/touch/Enter/Space enter Resumen and logout/reset work. Other SVG row actions/tooltips, textual modal/config/clinical controls, upper-right Agregar+, 8px icon gaps and source palette/fonts remain unchanged. Latest author HTTP2355 and independent baseline/candidate25 checks passed with zero forbidden external/API/storage operations or page errors; actual50236 direct URL passed all input modes. No real authentication, backend, prescribing, payment, storage or native authority approval.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Preserved connected prototype, not production software. New single full-width text login CTA fixes the inert-caption/arrow-only trap without changing submit/session/business handlers. Literal caption mouse/touch/Enter/Space and logout/reset passed; exact financial/patient/clinical/config action signatures match baseline. Existing role gating, free descriptive studies, human clinical drafts, service-only billing/receipts and responsive accessibility remain. Latest proof2355 author +25 independent, plus actual direct-URL acceptance; canvas is visual review only. All data fictional and reset on reload; no backend/security certification.
